en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a long, tree‑lined avenue leading towards the center of a town with hills in the background. On the right side stands a prominent church with a tall spire and arched windows, surrounded by low buildings and fenced open ground covered with circus posters. A horse‑drawn carriage and a few pedestrians are visible on the wide street. The front has printed captions at the top reading "Pécs" on the left and "Látkép" on the right. The reverse side is a divided back postcard in Hungarian, labeled "LEVELEZŐ‑LAP," with address lines and a small imprint of the publisher at the bottom.
